Use OPA Gatekeeper for attacks 1 and 2 (need ConstraintTemplate + Constraint for each). Use Kyverno ClusterPolicy for attacks 3, 4, 5 (require-limits, no-untagged-images, block-admin-sa).

For OPA: create a ConstraintTemplate named BlockPrivilegedContainer with Rego that checks container.securityContext.privileged == true. Then create a constraint BlockPrivilegedContainer with match.kinds=[{"":"Pod"}] and namespaces=[dojo-sec-gauntlet].

After applying all 5 policies, wait 10-15 seconds for the admission webhooks to sync, then run bash verify.sh. If some policies still fail, re-read the error from verify.sh to see which attack is not yet blocked.
